title: Second-level polynomial hierarchy characterization
statement: For every language $L$ of bit strings, membership in the class defined by an efficient two-witness predicate with polynomially bounded witness lengths is equivalent to membership in $\Sigma_2^P$. Explicitly, there are a polynomial-time language $V$ and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, for every bit string $x$, $x\in L$ if and only if there is a bit string $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$ for which every bit string $v$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$ satisfies $\langle\langle x,u\rangle,v\rangle\in V$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings.
